```python
import pandas as pd

riordan_segment = """
The Lightning Thief
Rick Riordan
Disney Hyperion
Fantasy

The Mark of Athena
Rick Riordan
Disney Hyperion
Fantasy
Checked Out
The House of Hades
Rick Riordan
Disney Hyperion
Fantasy
Overdue
"""

lines = [l.strip() for l in riordan_segment.strip().split('\n') if l.strip()]
records = [lines[i:i+5] for i in range(0, len(lines), 5)]
df = pd.DataFrame(records, columns=["Title","Author","Publisher","Genre","Status"]) 

not_on_shelves = {"checked out", "overdue"}
riordan_not_shelves = df[df["Status"].str.lower().isin(not_on_shelves)]
print("Number of Rick Riordan books not currently on the library’s shelves:", len(riordan_not_shelves))
print("\nList of titles and their status:")
print(riordan_not_shelves[["Title","Status"]])
```
